newsitem.title: USA: USDA changes El Salvador PL480 for soymeal, vegoil.
newsitem.headline: USDA changes El Salvador PL480 for soymeal, vegoil.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Wednesday said it changed the Public Law 480, Title I, purchase authorizations issued to El Salvador in April for soybean meal and vegetable oil.
USDA said the authorization for soybean meal was lowered to $3.1 million from $6.0 million and the quantity was lowered to 9,000 tonnes from about 20,000 tonnes.

USDA said the purchase authorization for vegetable oil was increased to $5.7 million from $2.8 million and the quantity was raised to about 11,000 tonnes from 5,400 tonnes. About $3.1 million of vegetable oil remains to be purchased under this authorization, it added.
